name: API Specification 9A 6-strand steel guy cable
description: API Specification 9A 6-strand steel guy cable named for offshore WHP service on a page read in the 20-year retrospective.

specifications.basis: 1999 Tarpon article: 6-strand steel cable to API Spec 9A; 2-in, 6 by 19 considered minimum; cables designed to 50% nominal breaking strength per API 9A.
